state:
- The causal chain lists CDK5 activation as the first event without a measurable link from cytoplasmic TDP-43 to that kinase. Add a pre-registered activation readout that must rise before the Nup98 phospho-occupancy gate, and treat failure of that order as rejection of CDK5 initiation.
- The title treats Nup98 phosphosites as already mapped, while the protocol only nominates residues after a phosphoproteomic gate, and the TDP-43 species stays unspecified as disease-linked. Name the inducible TDP-43 variant and state the claim as conditional on residues that meet the 1.5-fold rise and 50 percent CDK5-loss criteria.
- Selective barrier failure is decided with 10 kDa versus 70 kDa probes marked as unverified prior knowledge, on a six-hour grid that can miss a faster sequence. Calibrate the permeability pair in the same assay and add a 1–2 hour sample so temporal precedence is fixed by observation rather than by those cutoffs.
